reviewCadence: Weekly reliability and error-budget review; monthly capacity review; quarterly DR/security/provider compatibility drill

signals.name: API latency
signals.target: p95 < 1500 ms excluding durable background processing

signals.name: Connector queue
signals.critical: dead_letter > 0 or no checkpoint progress > 30 minutes

signals.name: Connector completeness
signals.target: No confirmed finance result from partial coverage
signals.warning: partial coverage rate > 10%; distinguish missing scopes from provider outage

signals.name: D1 capacity
signals.warning: 70% of configured per-database size or query/write budget
signals.critical: 85%; owner must populate current plan limits

signals.name: R2
signals.warning: Unexpected object growth or storage error rate > 1%

errorBudgetPolicy: Freeze nonessential releases when the 28-day availability budget is exhausted; prioritize mitigation and a reviewed recovery plan.
